properties.areaDesc: Wasatch Mountains South of I-80; Western Uinta Mountains
properties.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 31 at 11:35AM MDT until November 2 at 11:00AM MST by NWS Salt Lake City UT
properties.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected, primarily for elevations above 8000ft. Total
snow accumulations 8 to 12 inches. Locally higher snow
accumulations above 10000ft within Little and Big Cottonwood and
Uintas 18 to 24 inches. Winds gusting as high as 45 mph.

* WHERE...Wasatch Mountains South of I-80 and Western Uinta
Mountains.

* WHEN...From 9 PM MDT this evening to 11 AM MST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult at times. Traction law
restrictions may be enacted. Gusty winds could bring down tree
branches.
properties.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. For winter road conditions
from the Utah Department of Transportation, visit
http://www.udottraffic.utah.gov.

For graphical depictions of the snowfall forecast, including Official
NWS Forecast, High End Amount, and Low End Amount, visit
weather.gov/slc/winter.

NWSheadline: WINTER WEATHER ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM 9 PM MDT THIS EVENING TO 11 AM MST MONDAY

properties.note: This is only a test for monitoring of vital dissemination systems.
